population.kidComparison: Over 1.4 billion people live here—the largest population of any country in the world!

geography.climate: Tropical monsoon climate in the south, warm plains in the center, and snow-capped Himalayan peaks in the far north.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Horizontal stripes of saffron orange, white, and green with a 24-spoke navy blue wheel in the center.

anthem.title: Jana Gana Mana
anthem.summary: Written by poet Rabindranath Tagore, celebrating India's diverse regions, rivers, and mountains.

exploration.didYouKnow: The game of chess was invented in India over 1,400 years ago!

regionalTraits: Always carries a pocket chessboard for long flights
Can name every spice in a dish from across the room
